about_title: Swiss tube end forming, from the compact expander to the CNC forming cell
about_text: Wecotech AG builds tube end forming machines in Switzerland for the exhaust, ventilation, chimney, automotive and water industries — 60 people, their own training workshop, and a reference list that runs from 3M, ABB and Alfa Laval to Akrapovič, American Axle and Audi. Every machine is built on Siemens controls with Bosch Rexroth hydraulics or servo drives, CE-certified, and programmed on the machine.

Four lines cover the shop and the production cell: the Easy line of compact expanders and reducers with the electrics and hydraulics in one housing; the Universal line of modular HW-Flex production machines; the Traditional line built for the C and IO tooling that is standard in the trade; and the Weco line of CNC inner / outer formers with 8 to 24 radial pistons and programmable tool rotation, for tube to Ø23.6″. Shearing cutters, a tube shear and a deburring machine complete the cell. NovoTech sells, installs and supports them in Canada from Mississauga, Ontario, Canada, with CSA-approved panels, remote maintenance and tooling to your tube.
